nodes.label: Window / Browser UI Icon (SVG)
nodes.description: A 16x16 SVG icon depicting a browser or application window. It shows a rectangular outer frame (full 16x16 viewBox) with a rounded inner panel and three small circular dots (radius 0.75) in the upper-left area, resembling macOS-style traffic-light window controls. The icon is rendered in gray (#666) with fill-rule evenodd. Commonly used as a UI icon to represent a browser window, app window, or desktop application context.
